title: first_jackpot

character.name: Виктор
character.design: man in his late twenties, lean build, tired sharp face, short dark hair with a messy fringe, faint stubble, deep-set grey eyes, wears a worn charcoal hoodie over a plain white tee, dark jeans, scuffed white sneakers, a cheap digital watch on the left wrist

world: from a grey late-90s post-Soviet apartment block to a neon crypto-era night city

shots.narration: в девяносто восьмом он собирал компьютер из чужого мусора
shots.visual: cramped grey apartment room at dusk, the character kneeling over a half-assembled beige PC surrounded by cables, dust in the lamp light, faded wallpaper, a cracked window showing panel houses
shots.motion: slow push-in toward the character, dust drifting in the lamp beam, monitor flicker

shots.narration: первый модем стоил дороже, чем месяц его работы
shots.visual: narrow electronics market stall at night, the character holding a boxed modem, harsh fluorescent tubes overhead, shelves crammed with beige hardware, breath visible in cold air
shots.motion: gentle handheld drift, flickering fluorescent light, background shoppers moving slowly

shots.narration: он играл ночами, пока весь подъезд спал
shots.visual: dark room lit only by a CRT monitor, the character hunched in the chair seen from a low angle, the glow painting his face, a mug and scattered notes on the desk
shots.motion: very slow dolly-in, monitor light pulsing, steam rising from the mug

shots.narration: восемь лет подряд он проигрывал почти всё
shots.visual: the same room years later, colder palette, the character sitting back from the desk with empty hands, walls covered in pinned printouts and crossed-out numbers
shots.motion: static frame with a barely perceptible push-in, papers trembling in a draft

shots.narration: а потом он перестал угадывать и начал считать
shots.visual: the character at a wide desk with three monitors full of green charts, an open notebook of handwritten formulas, early morning blue light through the blinds
shots.motion: slow lateral drift across the monitors, chart lines animating, blinds light shifting

shots.narration: в две тысячи семнадцатом его модель наконец сработала
shots.visual: neon-lit night city rooftop, the character standing at the railing looking at his phone, skyline of glowing towers behind him, rain-wet concrete reflecting the signs
shots.motion: slow rise and push-in, neon signs flickering, light rain drifting past

shots.narration: он не сорвал куш, он просто перестал терять
shots.visual: quiet modern apartment at dawn, the character calmly closing a laptop at a clean table, warm sunrise light across the floor, city visible through a large window
shots.motion: gentle push-in, sunlight slowly moving across the table, dust motes floating

shots.narration: и в этом вся разница между удачей и системой
shots.visual: the character walking away down a bright empty street, seen from behind, tall glass buildings on both sides, long morning shadows
shots.motion: slow tracking shot following him from behind, shadows shifting, distant traffic
